name: Mystica
source:
She is a Magical girl that fights off the shadow monsters and poses for magazines for money. Some are thankful for Mystica’s deeds to protect the city from monsters. Some question the virtuous nature of this superhero. There is a chance that Ryou and Mystica may cross-paths. Whether Ryou is ready or not when and if it happens is another matter entirely.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=47]MangaGamer[/url]]
